procedures.name: UpdateDialog
procedures.doc: Updates the posting progress dialog with current posting state and progress information.

procedures.name: UpdateDialogUpdateBalLines
procedures.doc: Updates the posting progress dialog specifically for balance lines update operations.

procedures.name: ConfirmPostingUnvoidableChecks
procedures.doc: Confirms posting of journal lines that require unvoidable validation checks. Specifically validates manual check transactions without balancing accounts and prompts for user confirmation.

procedures.name: SetPreviewMode
procedures.doc: Sets the posting batch to preview mode to prevent actual database commits during posting operations. Used for posting preview functionality to analyze posting impacts without permanent changes.

procedures.name: SetSuppressCommit
procedures.doc: Controls whether database commits are suppressed during posting operations. Used for testing scenarios or batch operations where commits should be managed externally.

procedures.name: InsertPostedGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Creates posted general journal line records from successfully posted journal lines. Archives journal line data for audit trail and historical reference if batch is configured for copying.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckDocumentNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating document numbers for journal lines. Enables custom processing or additional validation after document number checks are complete.

procedures.name: OnAfterCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing all posting batch operations. Enables cleanup, logging, or additional processing after journal batch posting is finished.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyGenJnlLineBalancingData
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying balancing account data between journal lines. Enables modification or validation of copied balancing information.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetPostingStateMsg
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after determining the posting state message text. Enables customization of progress messages shown during posting operations.

procedures.name: OnAfterPostGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after posting an individual general journal line. Enables post-processing, logging, or additional operations after line posting completion.

procedures.name: OnAfterPostGenJournalLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after posting a general journal line with result status. Enables result processing and validation after individual line posting operations.

procedures.name: OnAfterProcessLines
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing batch processing of general journal lines. Enables custom post-processing logic and finalization tasks after batch posting operations.

procedures.name: OnAfterShouldSetDocNoToLastPosted
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after determining whether to set document number to last posted value. Enables custom logic for document number assignment and sequential numbering validation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckBalance
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing balance validation for journal batch processing. Enables custom balance checking logic and validation rule customization for posting operations.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckCorrection
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing correction validation for journal line processing. Enables custom correction logic and validation rule customization for document correction scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckGenPostingType
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating general posting type for journal line processing. Enables custom posting type validation and account type-specific business rule enforcement.

procedures.name: OnBeforeClearDataExchEntries
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before clearing data exchange entries for journal line processing. Enables custom data exchange cleanup logic and integration with external data sources.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before starting batch posting processing for general journal lines. Enables custom initialization logic and preprocessing workflows before posting operations begin.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCountGenJournalLines
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before counting general journal lines for batch processing. Enables custom line counting logic and filtering for batch operation scope determination.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCommit
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before committing database transactions during batch posting. Enables custom commit logic and transaction management for posting operations.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCopyFields
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before copying fields during journal line processing. Enables custom field copying logic and data transformation workflows.
